mentl/0c84eab:
Pin the semantics that license the beautiful surface xs |> filter(.age > 18):
a parameter list is a product node-kind, and a call with a field absent is a
VALUE — the function awaiting that field. Partial application, defaults,
labeled args, the |> pipe (hole-completion), and the multi-shot continuation
resume-slot are ONE primitive: hole-filling keyed by IDENTITY (the named
field), never by position. The ?? marker names which field across the whole
medium (synth hole, argument hole, continuation resume-slot — the cursor
reading the same absence at three altitudes: SPACE and TIME are one). Add
E_PipeIntoComplete / E_PipeHoleAmbiguous to the diagnostic catalog.

Also: unify <| / >< as two surfaces of one PFanout node (ownership-keyed,
not two primitives); add E_ResumeWorldMismatch; expand the token catalog to
64 variants with checksum; full partial-application §; IFC interpolation-row
section; comments-as-graph-content dissolution of ///-vs-// split; dissolve
capability keyword into type row alias; refine the diagnostic catalog
structure as DiagKind ADT projection.

sonido/0c58a02:
Remove Vec usage from gain.rs test that broke --no-default-features builds.
Rewrite monotonicity check to track previous value instead of collecting —
simpler logic, zero allocation.

Add settled flag to SmoothedParam so advance() skips the one-pole math
when current ≈ target. The flag is invalidated by set_target() (with
epsilon check so redundant calls preserve the fast path) and set by
set_immediate(), snap_to_target(), and advance() itself on convergence.
is_settled() becomes a field read instead of an epsilon comparison.

Struct stays at 24 bytes (5×f32 + bool + padding). Every effect benefits
on every sample where params aren't moving — the common case in real usage.
two-top/0ca39fb:
decode_packet panicked on bincode failure of anything a peer sent on
the ggrs channel, mirroring matchbox's reference impl. The public room
pairs arbitrary strangers, so one malformed packet aborted the app
rather than losing the match. Return Option, warn, and let the
existing silence FSM (DISCONNECT_AFTER_FRAMES -> FORFEIT_AFTER_FRAMES)
score a peer that only sends garbage as the walk-away.

ggrs itself still expects on per-player input bytes inside a
well-formed Message (protocol.rs:107 in 0.12), an upstream issue; this
closes the half we own. The decode-success path is the same bincode
call as before, so paired peers are unaffected.
noodles/0ccf8d3:
A selected color runs forever even while its track is silent, and so do
the synth layers, lane filters, and the harmony chorus behind it — all
processing silence whenever a lane is empty, a clip is stopped, or a stem
render mutes the track. One cut at the color junction (trackOut, the node
feeding colorDest) takes the whole source side out of the rendered graph:
the live transport parks a track untriggered for 6 s (tails ring out
first) and every trigger path wakes it synchronously before scheduling —
including arrangement playback, which bypasses the scene-mode wrappers
and wakes through vstate like the motion recorder does. Empty steps never
wake. Offline solo renders park muted tracks statically while still
scheduling them, so the kick keeps the duck pumping on stems.

Receipts: stem renders drop ~40% (5401 to 3155 ms dry, 5640 to 3452 wet,
same box minutes apart) with stem rms bit-consistent (-10.5 dry, -7.5
wet); dry master rms unchanged at -5.1 across park/wake cycles; smoke
green. The strip below the cut stays wired so meters read truthful
silence, and a color swap resets the park flag or the junction rewire
would desync it.

stoop/0c07e55:
A file handed on from a device that had shown an issue's landing carried
that rendered page inside it, cover photograph and all, so a one-paragraph
piece weighed as much as an issue and held somebody else's words. The
landing and every other rendered list are emptied on the way out.

Opening a piece file now puts the piece in the tray: that is what the
editor meant by opening it, and it used to land on the desk with nothing
there. Only the person who signed it joins the roster. Making the next
issue from a file asks who is writing first; the file's roster came with
somebody else as the default author, so a reader's piece went out under the
editor's name. And a device with work of its own no longer adopts the
roster of whatever file it opens.

Flowing the pieces again asks before replacing a page changed by hand
since the last flow. Deleting a scrap or a piece is undone from the toast,
and its photograph is only swept once nothing can bring it back. The PDF
clips each page to itself, as the screen and the browser's print always
did; a cutting over the edge printed onto its neighbour, upside down in
the flipped row. The empty cover's hint has its spaces back.

The build drops whole-line comments from the shipped script. They stay in
src/ for whoever works on the press; every issue file carried them to
every reader. The page goes from 243 KB to 209 KB.
